Netanagri Full Episode:
What did Rajdeep say to Lal Krishna Advani—a prominent BJP leader considered to be Narendra Modi’s political mentor—that led to the interview being cut short and resulted in him getting a reprimand? Were there leaders in the BJP who held a stature greater than that of Advani or Atal? Watch this video to find out.
